name: testing-tool
description: A Postman-like web tool for testing HTTP APIs (TypeScript)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix mcp run typecheck
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,mcp -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:mcp"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix mcp install
